Hi Amelia — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment from a security/compliance perspective:

- Scope: Sapphire Health evaluating Redwood for patient-data powered clinical workflows (HIPAA scope flagged).
- Key asks from your side: SOC 2 status, subprocessor inventory, data residency and encryption controls, and a BAA if we move to production.
- Redwood asks: clarification on which data categories will be PHI vs. pseudonymized metadata; preferred deployment (hosted vs Private/VPC).

Requested next steps / commitments: 
1) Can you share the vendor security questionnaire you mentioned and procurement contact (copied here) — if you already have a PDF, please attach.
2) We'll send our current subprocessor list + a short data-flow diagram by EOD tomorrow.
3) Please confirm whether a signed BAA will be required prior to a pilot (we can prepare a standard redline).
4) Proposed follow-up: 30-min session w/ your security + our security (Rishi) on Wed 11/24 or Thu 11/25 to walk the questionnaire and clarify storage/residency constraints.

A couple of notes up front: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit in 2025; we offer a BAA for HIPAA-covered workloads and can support US-only data residency in a dedicated region. I'll attach the artifacts in my next message.

Thanks again — I want to keep this lightweight and action-focused. If the procurement contact wants a copy of our standard contracting timeline, I can send it.

Cheers,
